note: Accountability wording is a condensed paraphrase of the role's eight key accountabilities as described in the framework brief. Confirm against the actual job description before sharing.

accountabilities.text: Deliver reliable, performant on-car chassis control systems within the driver-in-the-loop simulator.
Prepare and manage SECU software release packages for simulator events, including calibrations, logging configuration and version control.
Provide guidance on control-system behaviour to drivers, race engineers and vehicle performance groups during sessions.
Maintain deep familiarity with on-car ECU software and hardware and with the DIL simulator systems.
Develop simulator systems and tooling, including dSPACE hardware-in-the-loop capability.
Bridge DIL and car control systems; catalogue and maintain documentation on differences between them.
Provide analytical, objective feedback on faults and liaise across functions to close them out.
Contribute to the wider Controls & Systems Group across rigs, dynos, tests and car tasks.

phases.name: Observe & baseline
phases.intent: No targets yet. Shadow sessions, map the real toolchain, establish which KPIs are measurable with existing data.
phases.deliverable: One-page proposed measurement plan + open questions.
checklist: Shadow at least 6 DIL sessions end-to-end
Map the actual toolchain (SECU generation, dSPACE stack, logging, ATLAS/System Monitor)
Identify Alpine's existing CSG KPI structures to plug into
Mark each of the 22 KPIs measurable / needs-instrumentation / drop
Agree the stakeholder-survey rater groups with the Head of CSG

phases.name: Instrument & baseline numbers
phases.intent: Stand up lightweight capture. Record baselines with no judgement attached.
phases.deliverable: Populated baseline dataset for the headline KPIs.
checklist: Add session-log fields: scheduled vs productive minutes, disruption cause
Add fault fields in Jira/Azure DevOps: severity, root cause, recurrence link
Tag SECU releases in Git for lead-time and buffer measurement
Create the DIL-vs-car difference catalogue page
Run the first data pull end-to-end into this tool

phases.name: Agree targets & first review
phases.intent: Convert baselines into 6–8 headline KPIs with the manager and hold the first formal check-in.
phases.deliverable: Agreed headline scorecard with owned targets.
checklist: Select the 6–8 headline KPIs with the Head of CSG
Replace every illustrative target with an agreed one
Drop or redesign any KPI that could not be measured cleanly
Hold the 30-60-90 review with the scorecard as the artefact

phases.name: Consolidate
phases.intent: Automate collection so the scorecard is a by-product of the work, not extra admin.
checklist: Automate collection from session logs, Git and the ticket system
Grow the difference catalogue toward completeness
Publish the known-fault playbook
Show the first improvement trend on two headline KPIs

phases.name: Ongoing cadence
phases.intent: Quarterly refresh of development OKRs, stakeholder survey and trend review; annual full scorecard review.
phases.deliverable: Quarterly review pack; annual scorecard revision.
checklist: Refresh 2–3 development OKRs each quarter
Run the quarterly stakeholder survey (≥3 raters per group)
Re-baseline targets each quarter while the rig beds in
Retire or replace low-value KPIs annually
